d: Cristiano Ronaldo has been handed a 30-day ban and a 285 US dollar fine by Portugal after his controversial walkout from the national team camp during the UEFA Nations League. But the timing of the suspension means he is not expected to miss a Portugal match. So, did the Portuguese Football Federation strike the right balance between punishing its captain and recognising his contribution to the country? Or does Ronaldo's status as Portugal's biggest football star make accountability a little more complicated? Rupha Ramani breaks down the Ronaldo controversy with Jorge Jesus, Portugal's…
